name: Ahihud (son of Shelomi)
title: Chieftain from the tribe of Asher
summary: Ahihud, son of Shelomi, was the chieftain from the tribe of Asher who was appointed to distribute the inheritance in Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Appointed to divide the land
keyEvents.description: Ahihud, son of Shelomi, was appointed as Asher's chieftain to distribute the inheritance in Canaan.
